lines.t: Shofars raise the victory song Lion of Judah leads the way
Brilliant dawn, no night, no gray Feet stomp the ancient ground
Brothers, sisters gather round Raise your banners, wave them high
Restore this earth, no more sighs
Celebrate, we shout, we run His kingdom come, the war is won
Dance and whirl, the streets ignite In His glory, fire and light
Jump, the echo shakes the sky, with one voice we testify
Our Shua reigns, he's crowned the king, garden blooms, the nation sings
Na na na na na na, na na na na na na na
Na na na na na na, na na na na na na
Unbroken circle, arms entwined
Laughter rises, joy divine
Base beneath our dancing feet
Victory pulse, the rhythm complete
Walls have fallen, chains undone
See the bride and spirit run
Glorious harvest, holy sound
Peace and power all around
Lift your heart, release your cry
Let the waves of triumph fly
Kings return forever praise
In his love Jerusalem raised
High exalted sovereign name
Hang every breath a burning flame
In Israel's children join the ring
Yahushua reigns
Eternal King
Day, day, day, day, day
